E1.evidence: Issue #1177 gives the full setup (ros2_control xacro, controller YAML, launch file) and the error log of the failed activation; a second user confirms the same behaviour in PR #1391 ("I am facing this exact issue"), and maintainer PR #2120 changes the resource manager behaviour the log exposes.

E2.evidence: The resource manager (host framework, ros2_control/hardware_interface) calls the plugin's prepare_command_mode_switch with every start/stop interface key, including keys of another hardware component; the plugin (tenfoldpaper/panda_ros2 franka_hardware) treats every key it receives as its own and rejects the switch because its own control mode is already set. The value that crosses the boundary (the interface-key list) is what the two sides disagree on: the host header states "All starting and stopping interface keys are passed to all components, so the function should return return_type::OK by default when given interface keys not relevant for this component", while the plugin's prepare_command_mode_switch never filters by its own joints. With fake_components/GenericSystem as the plugin the same host works (reporter: "Using only the _fake_components/GenericSystem_ everything works just fine"), and PR #2120 resolves it by changing what the host passes, so it is not an internal defect of either unit and not deployment wiring.

E3.evidence: PAIR: the host's output (the start-interface list for activating panda_3_arm_controller) feeds the plugin's prepare_command_mode_switch input, and the plugin's return value feeds the host's switch decision ("Could not switch controllers since prepare command mode switch was rejected").

E4.evidence: Observed failure: activation of panda_3_arm_controller is refused; log lines "Component 'panda_1_FrankaHardwareInterface' did not accept new command resource combination" and "Could not switch controllers since prepare command mode switch was rejected."

units.name: ros2_control
units.revision_basis: The reporter names only "ROS2 Humble" and "tested with ros2_control installed from binaries and from source". The humble branch head at the log timestamp (1700586290 = 2023-11-21) was tag 2.35.0 (commit 927ca588f98b7c044ead06ebcb3813e3f44dd0a9, 2023-11-14); the binary may have been an earlier 2.3x humble release. The per-component loop that passes the full start/stop lists to every component and prints "did not accept new command resource combination" was verified at 2.35.0. The resolving change is PR #2120, merged to master as 157beab216ee60e662bb03e66ae2b822bd3bda72 (2025-05-24) and backported to jazzy only (PR #2273, 0ca2ee9c833bbfb7fe7151ad234d1b30f26adb0e); there is no humble backport, so the resolved revision is on a later ROS 2 distribution than the reporter used.

units.name: franka_hardware
units.revision_basis: The reporter links franka_hardware "from [here](https://github.com/tenfoldpaper/panda_ros2/tree/humble/franka_hardware)" (humble branch, no commit). The humble branch head at the log timestamp (2023-11-21T17:04Z) by committer date was b8555c77a5d6 (2023-11-20T13:40:59Z); its prepare_command_mode_switch prints "Preparing command mode switch", "++ %s" and "Switching between control modes without stopping it first is not supported." exactly as in the reporter's log. The resolution (PR #2120) is in ros2_control only, so this unit keeps its broken revision.

failed_conditions.quote: This PR makes sure that the start and stop interfaces in `perform_command_mode_switch` and `prepare_command_mode_switch` methods of the Hardware components will receive only the interfaces they expose, instead of all of them as of now.

loudness_evidence: [resource_manager]: Component 'panda_1_FrankaHardwareInterface' did not accept new command resource combination: ... [controller_manager]: Could not switch controllers since prepare command mode switch was rejected. (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/1177)

resolution.summary: Resource manager filters the start/stop interface lists per hardware component before calling prepare_command_mode_switch / perform_command_mode_switch, and skips components with no matching interfaces (ros2_control PR #2120, master 157beab2; jazzy backport PR #2273). The alternative, per the humble header note, is for the plugin to return OK for interface keys that are not its own; that was not done in the franka_hardware fork.
resolution.evidence: Neither the reporter nor a maintainer shows the franka_hardware composition working with PR #2120. The PR #1391 author states after reading #2120: "Looking at the content it looks like that is exactly what I was looking for and fixes the problem." (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/pull/1391). The reporter closed the issue with a workaround in a different unit (MoveIt): "When I switch the controller manager to the moveit_simple_controller_manager/MoveItSimpleControllerManager this problem disappears."

notes: Primary evidence of the mismatch: the humble host header (system_interface.hpp at 2.35.0) says "All starting and stopping interface keys are passed to all components, so the function should return return_type::OK by default when given interface keys not relevant for this component"; the plugin's prepare_command_mode_switch applies "only allow new controller to be started if the current control mode is NONE" to whatever keys it receives. PR #2120 removed that header note and changed the host behaviour instead. The failure only arises when two hardware components are active and a controller on one is active while a controller on the other is activated (CONCURRENT between the two plugin instances / two arm controllers); both plugin instances are the same plugin in one ros2_control_node process, so they are not recorded as separate units. The refusal looks like an exclusive-resource conflict, but the requested panda_3 interfaces were unclaimed (list_hardware_components output) and the conflict comes only from misrouted keys, so it is classed `other`, not `exclusive_resource_conflict`. Reporter's YAML declares position command interfaces while the log shows effort interfaces being started; the log is taken as authoritative. The reporter's closing workaround changes MoveIt's controller-manager plugin (a different composition, MoveIt to ros2_control) and does not change either unit here. A later commenter (karanchahal) reports a different symptom (joint not found with topic-based systems), not part of this case. PR #1391 (unmerged) proposed an alternative host-side change.
